focus: correctness: moved test-harness roots and generated paths

findingDetails.title: Moved test harness retains retired roots and doubled dist path
findingDetails.evidence: The phase and embeddings harnesses resolve absent .opencode/skill or scripts paths; the embeddings path lands at absent runtime/shared/dist while shared/dist exists; the shipped-path assertion appends dist to an already compiled dist root and skips when absent.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite moved harness roots against .opencode/skills/system-spec-kit and runtime/cli, correct the shared traversal and generated-output path, and make the shipped-path assertion fail when its required artifact is missing rather than silently treating a path-contract error as an unbuilt skip.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct reads plus bounded existence checks for each referenced root and generated-output location.

results.notes: F001 remains active and the moved harnesses expose additional consumers of the incomplete package contract.
F009: moved harness paths do not resolve the files and outputs they claim to test.
Most tests use runtime/cli, but several executable harnesses retain retired roots.
Harness failures/skips can conceal relocation regressions.

reason: The manual runner has a correct .opencode/skills fallback; its historical report destination is an intentional fixture target and does not establish an additional relocation defect.
